projects.description: The {@link Genai.Project} this instance is linked to.

acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

description.description: An optional description of this source collection

rootUrl.description:
The url of the root folder for this collection. All files within this folder (including subfolders) will be
treated as part of the collection.

targetUrl.description: The url of the root folder where all files for embeddings, passages, etc for this collection should be stored.

files.description: All files that come from this collection.

fileCount.description: Count of all files for this collection.

system.description: The external source system this collection is a part of, if any.

combinedPassagesFile.description:
A single file containing the passages for all files in this collection. Effectively the concatenation/merge
of each file's passagesFile (which is a representation of all of the Genai.SourcePassages for the
SourceFile).

For SourceCollections that will be loaded into the Genai.Retriever in their entirety, this file should be used to
load the vector store instead of parsing each file.

This field should be accessed via `mergedPassages`

combinedPassagesFileIsStale.description:
A flag to indicate when SourceFiles in this Collection have been added, removed, or updated since
combinedPassagesFile was last created.

lastSyncedBy.description: The {@link User#email} who synced the source collection.

displayLastSyncedBy.description: Information about the user who synced the source collection formatted for display in the UI

indexedContentProvider.description:
Hook for the collection which overrides the default behavior for how {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata} is
embedded into a passage when it is indexed into the {@link Genai.Retriever}. Will only be called if the
{@link Genai.SourceCollection.Metadata.Config#embedMetadata} is set to true for this collection.
Also the contents of the Genai.SourcePassage can be added to the lambda and can be indexed.

syncMetadataLambda.description:
Lambda to override what {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata} is saved for a {@link Genai.SourceFile}
during the file syncing process

lastExecutedSyncMetadataLambda.description: Last sync metadata lambda function executed during sync (stringified)

lastSyncTime.description: The **start** time of the last sync

groups.description: The groups with access to this collection.

title: A Genai.SourceCollection defines a corpus of sources that can be parsed to serve a Generative AI search application.
name: Genai.SourceCollection
